hypotheses.A1_restricted_derivative_identity_is_exa: Every reported address's explicit restricted operator matches the native bilinear JVP to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.A2_leading_addresses_are_rank64_compact: Every covariance-cleaned leading-mode address reaches at least 0.80 held-out derivative R-squared at rank 64 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A3_leading_addresses_beat_random_compact: The median leading-address K90 is at most 75% of the median random-address K90.
hypotheses.A4_leading_addresses_have_clean_output_r: The leading addresses send at least half their derivative energy into the weight-derived leading output direction in median.
hypotheses.A5_output_role_beats_sign_nulls: Median leading-address output-role energy exceeds the 95th percentile of sign-null-derived addresses.
hypotheses.A6_rank64_compactness_transfers_ood: Median leading-address rank-64 R-squared is at least 0.80 on FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
hypotheses.A7_covariance_cleaning_shortens_addresse: The median K90 of covariance-cleaned leading addresses is lower than the median K90 of raw-form addresses.
hypotheses.A8_cleaned_address_subspace_is_split_sta: The top-four cleaned leading-address subspaces from even and odd discovery rows have mean canonical cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.A9_leading_mode_is_more_compact_than_non: Median K90 of leading-mode cleaned addresses is lower than that of cleaned addresses from output modes 1 through 3.
